message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "fallback_to_morphological_report_on_empty_classifier_findings", "description": "When a chest X-ray classifier returns no strong findings for images with suspected chronic structural pathology, invoke the report generator to extract detailed morphological descriptions.", "applicable_conditions": "Applicable when interpreting medical imaging (specifically chest X-rays) where initial automated classification yields negative or empty results despite clinical suspicion of subtle or chronic structural abnormalities (e.g., fibrosis, architectural distortion).", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "If `chest_xray_classifier` returns an empty `strong_findings` list but clinical context suggests chronic structural pathology: (1) Do NOT conclude the image is normal; (2) Immediately invoke `chest_xray_report_generator` to extract detailed morphological descriptions (e.g., volume loss, reticular patterns, architectural distortion); (3) Use these detailed descriptions for longitudinal comparison or further diagnostic reasoning."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
